name: Planet ⑨ (Beta)
author: Planet 9

sections.description:
Planet ⑨ is an innovative AI plugin for WordPress that supports content writing and translation without interrupting your workflow.

The plugin adds a smart floating toolbar to the bottom-right of your screen, giving you instant access to powerful AI functionality. Currently, the following assistants are available:

  • Teller: AI copywriting assistant
  • Linus: AI translation assistant

More assistants and features are coming soon.

An OpenAI API key is required to use the plugin. The plugin is fully privacy-friendly and does not store or track any data.

Features (v2.14):

  • Smart floating toolbar, active only in editable text fields
  • Generate content based on your input or pre-filled content
  • Improve grammar and spelling without changing the meaning
  • Auto-structure content (headings, lists, spacing)
  • Translate text into other languages with a dropdown selector
  • Compatible with most themes and plugins

Upcoming roadmap:

  • More assistants: image generation, code generation, etc.
  • Integration with page builders (Gutenberg, Elementor)
  • UX improvements
  • Field compatibility improvements

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to provide AI-powered writing, editing, and translation features.

Whenever a user activates one of the assistants (such as Teller or Linus), the selected or entered content is sent to the OpenAI service for processing. The plugin does not store or track any of this content locally or remotely.

To use the plugin, you need to enter your own OpenAI API key in the plugin settings. You can manage your usage and billing directly through your OpenAI account.

This service is provided by OpenAI. Please review their Terms of Use and Privacy Policy for more information.

A brief Markdown Example

Included assistants:

  • Teller – copywriting
  • Linus – translation

Key functions:

  1. Automatically activates on compatible text fields
  2. Smart, context-aware AI responses
  3. No data tracking or storage

Create and improve content with AI, right where you’re working.

Visit Planet ⑨ for more information.
sections.faq:
About the beta

In this beta version, the following assistants are available:

  • Teller – AI copywriter
  • Linus – AI translator

For now, both are integrated into a single toolbar. In future versions, you will be able to customize which assistants are active and how the toolbar appears.

How does the toolbar work?

Once the plugin is installed, a toolbar will appear fixed in the bottom-right corner of your screen. It will only activate when you click inside a text field that is compatible with the plugin.

Important: You must enter your OpenAI API key in the plugin settings before the AI tools will function.

  • Pencil icon: Write your own prompt first in the field, e.g. “Write a paragraph about…”. The AI will generate content based on it.
  • Star icon: The AI generates content automatically based on other filled-in fields (great for titles, excerpts, etc.).
  • ABC icon: Improves spelling and grammar without changing the actual meaning.
  • Structure icon: Adds formatting and structure (such as headings and lists), without changing the content.
  • Language selector: Translates the selected content to your chosen language.
